benchmark.h201: SWE-bench Verified, wey we measure for one DGX Spark
benchmark.p02: On 2026-10-08, Mightling 1.5.1 agent with Qwen3.8-27B solve 68 out of 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks for one DGX Spark, offline: fixed sample of 100 tasks, one attempt per task, default mode. If you scale am to all 500 tasks, na estimated ≈69% (95% band 63.9–73.4%). Na our own measurement, for our own machine and for a subset, no be leaderboard entry.

benchmark.p29: Read am as company, no be ranking. For di same 100 tasks Mightling solve as many as Qwen3-Coder-480B and GLM-4.6, models wey big pass am many times, but every row dey use different agent, different hardware and, for di leaderboard rows, di official x86 test images, while our own run for community arm64 images. For refine mode, one first session go study di task without changing anything, then new session go do am: e solve one task pass di default (69 against 68, each side win tasks wey di oda one lose), for about 2.2 times di time per task, so e remain opt-in (ling --refine).
benchmark.p31: 100 tasks na one fifth of Verified, so di full-set figure na estimate. We fit one-parameter item-response (Rasch) model on di per-task results of all 175 public Verified submissions: every task get difficulty and every system get ability. Mightling ability na di one wey explain 68 solved for dis 100 tasks; ≈69% na di expected score of dat ability for all 500 (plain regression on di published scores agree within one point). To check am, we score every public submission for dis 100 tasks alone and predict im overall score di same way: di error na 2.4 points (RMSE), and di band wey dey up na ±1.96 times dat. Every number for di table, scripts/swe_bench_compare.py dey reproduce am from di public per-task data of SWE-bench/experiments.
benchmark.p32: Di 100 tasks spread across Verified repositories in proportion to di full set, among di tasks wey dia test environment dey run and validate for arm64 (di gold patch pass, empty change fail). Published systems dey score 1.0 to 1.5 points low pass all 500 for dis 100, so di sample no easy. E no be leaderboard entry: SWE-bench team dey grade those one for dia own infrastructure.

try.p02: Or put work for tonight queue with /night add <task>: Mightling go work through di queue while you dey sleep, each task for im own git branch, and you go review di branches with coffee for hand.
proof.h201: Your code no dey leave your table — and you fit prove am
proof.p02: Cloud coding agents dey send your source code go anoda person servers. Mightling no dey send am anywhere: di model dey run for your GB10, and nothing inside Mightling dey phone home. No usage analytics, no metrics, no sign-in, no "anonymous" crash reports. Dat one make e fit work for code wey dem no allow you upload: client work, regulated data, unreleased products.
proof.p03: One command dey run real Mightling session under strace and list every network connection wey e make:
proof.p04: Everything stay for 127.0.0.1. Not even one DNS lookup.
proof.p06: Type /airgapped on and every command wey di agent run go get empty network namespace from di Linux kernel. E no be polite request to di model: network just no dey to reach. Full Access, wey for bypass di sandbox, dem go refuse am at di same time.
proof.p08: Only wetin you or di agent ask for: web search (through private SearXNG for your own machine), page fetch, read-only request to Google account wey you connect, or update check. For /airgapped on, none of dem.
why.p03: Di model, your code, your prompts and your answers dey stay for di machine wey dem dey.
why.li05: Egress audit wey you fit run again
why.p14: Single stream for GB10 with speculative decoding. Dem measure agent work over real agent sessions; code, JSON and prose by kind of output, with greedy decoding. Run four agents at once: no quota, no "abeg wait".
why.h315: ✨ Nothing wey you need set up
why.li16: No tuning: model, context, kernels and speculative decoding dem don choose am for di GB10.
why.li17: E no go freeze your machine: dem dey check di host and dey watch memory pressure during di load.
why.li18: Your oda machines go find am for di local network.

paper.h302: Architecting Local, Air-Gap-Capable Desktop Clients for Agentic AI Pair Programmers: Protocol Compatibility, Process Isolation, and Host Memory Safety
paper.p04: We present di architectural design, formal capability model, and empirical evaluation of Mightling Desktop, one open-source desktop environment wey dey speak di same app-server protocol as di upstream vendor desktop client, keep Codex-compatible defaults, run inference for di user own hardware, and confine every sandboxed command to di workstation when di user turn /airgapped on.
faq.p03: Yes, to run di model. Your oda computers dey use am as clients: Linux (Arm or x86) and macOS with di same install command, Windows (Arm or x86, preview) with di PowerShell line.
faq.summary04: I don install Puffin. Na im be dis?
faq.p05: Yes: dem rename Puffin to Mightling for 1.5. Run puffin update once, then puffin one last time. E go move your sessions, settings and links come, and from then di command na ling.
faq.p07: Yes. Mightling na open source under di AGPL, and di model weights free. Di only running cost wey you get na electricity.
faq.summary08: Wetin I need apart from di machine?
faq.p09: Di OS wey e come with (DGX OS 7, or Ubuntu 24.04 where di vendor offer am), Docker with di NVIDIA Container Toolkit, Python 3 and Git. For plain Ubuntu, ling-admin host check go tell you wetin dey miss.
faq.p11: Only wetin you or di agent ask for, like web search through SearXNG for your own machine, and di first-time downloads. /airgapped on dey turn all of am off.
faq.p13: Qwen3.8-27B for NVIDIA 4-bit NVFP4 format, wey SGLang dey serve with DFlash2 drafter, dem choose and tune am for di GB10. About 20 GB of weights; roughly 38 GB of di machine memory go remain free while e dey serve.
cta.h201: Keep your code for your table
cta.p02: If you believe say code suppose stay for di table wey dem write am, star di repository: na so oda GB10 owners dey find Mightling.
